works.title: Untitled (Figure, Blue Ground)
works.description: Vertical mixed-media collage on red ground incorporating compact discs at each corner, a floppy disk at bottom center, drawn numerals along the margins, and a central layered column of printed ephemera, braided cord, patterned fabric, and a small biplane image positioned near a photographed face fragment.
works.composition: axial vertical totem on flat ground

works.title: Reliquary
works.description: Lace doilies border a rectangular collage centered on a yellow Latin cross, above which six black vertical bars extend upward, each topped with a silver compact disc. Additional CDs line the lower interior edge and outer border, set against layered translucent fabric with printed text and a violet ground.
works.composition: centered shrine on dark ground

works.title: Sortie
works.description: Two oversized gold compact discs sit in concentric black-and-white halos in the upper register; below, a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane is centered on a blue bullseye. A frieze of small scoring targets runs along the base, with vertical orange and black bands dividing the field.
works.composition: two-register: paired discs above, plane-on-target below

works.title: Alley, Magenta Figure
works.description: Narrow urban alleyway surfaces covered in layered spray-paint murals, including a central white-plastered section depicting a magenta-headed figure wearing oversized purple-and-yellow sunglasses above a skeletal torso in red and black. Flanking walls carry additional multicolored tags and characters; a silver Moto Guzzi Griso motorcycle is parked at the base.

works.composition: diagonal pair on metallic ground
works.description: Two top-down warplane line drawings drift across a silver foil ground, partially overlapping. A wooden chess king stands as a counterweight at lower left; silver compact discs anchor the upper corners and beaded fringes hang at the base.
works.title: Endgame

works.composition: diagonal plane axis with chess weight right
works.description: Mixed-media collage on black ground incorporating multiple compact discs—including a pink Verbatim CD-R and several silver-toned discs—overlaid with line-drawn warplane diagrams, a wooden chess king piece, yellow target stickers, iridescent foil fragments, and beaded cord arranged across layered transparent and reflective surfaces.
works.title: Squadron with Pink Vinyl
Procession
works.description: Vertical totem composition on pale yellow ground: a warplane photograph positioned at the apex descends through tiered arrangements of gold and silver compact discs, hand-drawn concentric circles, grid-patterned paper strips, and a black photographic band at lower center, flanked by four vertical yellow painted lines.
works.composition: axial vertical totem on light ground
open upper field, dense lower frieze
works.description: Top-down line drawing of a propeller warplane with RAF roundels occupies the upper portion of a white ground, bisected by two vertical yellow bands. Below, collaged elements include a gold scallop-patterned rectangle bearing a turquoise star, three silver compact discs, a football, a concentric-circle target, and rows of printed dots along the right margin.
works.title: Drafting Table

works.composition: diagonal plane crossover on metallic ground
works.description: Two top-down warplanes overlap diagonally on a textured gold-leaf and silver-foil ground, one ghosted with bullseye eyes. A wooden chess king holds the lower-left corner; gold and iridescent discs cluster in the corners over a faint scoring sheet.
works.title: Treasury

works.composition: axial totem on dotted ground, dense base pile
works.description: Mixed-media collage layering compact discs, yellow tape strips, holographic foil fragments, and printed technical diagrams onto a perforated white ground. Centrally positioned, a hand-drawn aircraft outline incorporates iridescent CDs as landing gear and engine components, surrounded by target rings, red ink splashes, and photographic fragments at the lower register.
works.title: Float

works.composition: diagonal cascade of discs over central plane
works.description: Three silver compact discs cascade down a gold-foil ground over a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane. Strips of red lettering and small game-target stickers line the upper edge; the surface is densely worked, with overlapping foils and crease marks.
works.title: Untitled (Three Discs Descending)

works.composition: central plane with disc constellation, target frieze base
works.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three iridescent compact discs suspended over overlapping printed ephemera, including a technical warplane diagram, concentric target motifs, and photographic fragments. Orange vertical bands and red diagonal elements intersect a lower register of numbered columns and small figurative imagery against a predominantly pale ground.
works.title: Untitled (Iridescent Squadron)
Hieroglyph
works.description: Collaged layers juxtapose a reproduced Egyptian wall-painting of a seated deity—bearing a solar disc headdress and hieroglyphic register above—with a line-drawn warplane ascending from below. Yellow tape strips run vertically across the composition; compact discs occupy upper corners; a football helmet, iridescent sequin strips, and scattered marbles accumulate at the lower edge.
works.composition: centered iconographic panel with framing bands

works.title: Disc Crucifix
works.description: Mixed-media assemblage incorporating five iridescent compact discs arranged along a T-shaped form above layered panels of reflective black, dark green, and white materials. White cables and wires hang loosely downward from the central structure, alongside small electronic components and blue-painted fragments affixed to the surface.
works.composition: asymmetric cross at upper left, dripping strings below

works.title: Gold Cross
works.description: Cross-shaped assemblage constructed from gold metallic panels, four compact discs, and layered mixed-media detritus, centered against a red-and-white cruciform field on a black ground. Reflective surfaces, fragmentary electronic components, and vinyl-like material cover the cross's interior, with red-painted passages visible beneath.
works.composition: centered cross on red square, black ground
central plane on light field, dense base frieze
works.description: Mixed-media collage centered on a top-down line-drawn warplane over layered CD-R packaging, holographic foil, and iridescent tape. Four Skilcraft compact discs are affixed at corners; a football, red helmet, paper clips, and concentric target forms occupy the lower register alongside yellow-accented gear shapes.
works.title: Fuselage and Helmet
Untitled (Football and Vinyl)
works.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating compact discs, vinyl records, holographic foil, technical schematic paper, football trading cards, a red helmet, and a brown football arranged across a white ground. Vertical color-bar strips and concentric-circle targets occupy the left and right margins, while iridescent disc surfaces reflect multiple colors throughout the composition.
works.composition: discs upper, sport-card frieze lower
vertical squadron with disc and target field
works.description: Multiple top-down warplane line drawings stack in a vertical formation against a field crowded with gold compact discs, red rocket-fin shapes and concentric target rings. Vertical orange and black bands divide the composition; printed numerals and tags pile at the base.
works.title: Formation

works.composition: left-aligned plane with disc and snapshot drift
works.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three gold compact discs, a side-view warplane drawing, postage stamps, polaroid-style photographic prints, and multicolored painted ribbons against a predominantly white ground. Concentric target rings appear at upper center and lower left, alongside holographic foil fragments, hand-drawn architectural lines, and bold red, yellow, and black gestural strokes.
works.title: Untitled (Polaroid Drift)

works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, asymmetric weighting right
works.description: Layered fragments of printed ephemera—a football trading card, photoprints, paper clips, and compass drawings—overlay a warplane outline rendered in fine linework at left, with bold vertical color bands in red, yellow, and blue. Concentric target circles and a compact disc dominate the right half against a dark blue ground.
works.title: Untitled (Plane and Disc, Wide)

works.composition: horizontal panorama with twin disc anchors
works.description: Layered collage elements across a horizontal format include two iridescent compact discs set within concentric circular targets, outlined propeller-aircraft drawings, diagonal pastel bars, a soccer ball, an Arsenal Football Club logo, and dense overlapping fragments of printed ephemera, color-block tape, and photographic imagery on a cream ground.
works.title: Wide Score

works.composition: axial vertical with crown apex and target base
works.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating compact discs, printed ephemera, football imagery, and iridescent foil arranged around a centered top-down aircraft line drawing. Vertical orange stripes cross the composition; concentric black-and-white target circles, a holographic crown element, and a Rolling Stones tongue logo punctuate the densely layered field.
works.title: Crowned Plane

works.composition: central plane on stacked targets, axial symmetry
works.description: Centered top-down outline of a military aircraft overlays concentric black-and-white target rings, surrounded by collaged printed ephemera including gold compact discs, bullseye targets, photographic snapshots, red and orange vertical ribbon forms, and a football, arranged across a dense multi-layered white ground.
works.title: Bombsight

works.composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc anchors with central target
works.description: Layered printed ephemera and physical objects—compact discs, archery targets, Rolling Stones tongue-and-lips logos, an Arsenal badge, and an engineering-drawing warplane—are collaged across a black ground with vertical red and yellow paper strips. Gold glitter material occupies the center, flanked by four silver CDs along the lower register and a small football at lower right.
works.title: Tongue and Plane
Cloud Garden
works.description: Five gold compact discs are affixed across a loosely painted white ground featuring gestural blue and green brushwork depicting a schematic face with circular eyes. Collaged USPS Express Mail labels, two outlined aircraft, a small snowman figure, and multicolored rectangular patches occupy the composition's margins and lower register.
works.composition: soft painted ground with central disc cluster

works.title: Yellow Figure on Black Wall
works.description: Yellow stenciled human silhouette, posed mid-stride, sits centered within a layered spray-painted field of magenta, red, and orange on a black wall covered with overlapping white and turquoise graffiti tags. Small snowman motifs flank the central figure; cyan bubble lettering occupies the lower register alongside a partially visible printed flyer.

works.title: Untitled (Twin Planes)
works.description: Two top-down warplane drawings stack vertically on a gold-foil ground. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper field; a small linear bird and a band of sequined dots sit below the lower plane.
works.composition: vertical stack of plane pair on metallic ground

works.description: Large-scale mixed-media mural covering an entire wall, densely layered with collaged imagery including footballs, concentric target circles, chess pieces, cameras, and photographic fragments rendered in saturated reds, blacks, yellows, and whites. Painted and printed elements overlap continuously across the surface without visible negative space.
works.title: Installation View, Wall of Works
Installation View, Crowd
works.description: Wide installation photograph of a large white-ground mural densely covered in concentric circles, planes, footballs and target patterns. Three viewers stand in silhouette in the foreground, giving scale.

works.composition: diving plane upper, horizontal disc row lower
works.description: Top-down rendered warplane in cyan and dark ink overlaps a horizontal cyan band dividing the composition into two registers. Below, five gold compact discs and three circular orange-and-black target graphics are distributed across a pale architectural grid background.
works.title: Untitled (Diving Plane)

works.composition: diving plane upper, weeping figure lower
works.description: Layered digital collage featuring a rendered Stuka dive-bomber descending over partial cyan text, above a pale grid field populated with concentric target circles and a cubist-style reclining figure; two compact discs appear at left edge and lower center, with a horizontal orange-red gradient band bisecting the lower third.
works.title: Stuka, Watch Out

works.composition: wide horizontal frieze, dense uniform pattern
works.description: Wide horizontal collage-style composition dense with overlapping motifs: concentric bullseye targets in black, red, and pink; football forms; biplane silhouettes; chess pawn figures; vertical yellow bands; and hand-lettered text reading 'dias' at center. Red, black, white, and yellow dominate across a frieze-like expanse approximately three times wider than tall.
works.title: Long Frieze

works.composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc targets framing center
works.description: Mixed-media collage on a horizontal ground incorporates USPS Priority Mail envelopes, outlined warplane silhouettes, concentric target circles, iridescent compact discs, a football, red chess pawn, cartoon figure cutouts, and neon yellow and red rectangular overlays. Layered printed ephemera and hand-drawn elements occupy the entire picture plane in a dense, overlapping arrangement.
works.title: Untitled (Twin Discs in Targets)

works.composition: horizontal triptych, framed central panel
works.description: Dense collage across a horizontal format incorporates outlined warplane silhouettes, compact discs, concentric target motifs, football forms, graffiti lettering, and vertical red and yellow color blocks on a white ground. Handwritten text fragments appear at multiple edges alongside ink splashes and stenciled figures.
works.title: Hangar

works.composition: horizontal diptych, twin plane-and-disc panels
works.description: Three-panel horizontal collage incorporating black-outlined warplane drawings, gold compact discs, and concentric circular target motifs scattered across white grounds. Layered elements include chess pieces, handwritten text, photographic fragments, red paint splatters, and multicolored striped borders dividing the panels.
works.title: Untitled (Plane Diptych)

works.composition: horizontal panorama, all-over roundel field
works.description: Horizontal mixed-media collage dominated by repeated concentric roundels in red, white, blue, and black distributed across a white ground alongside silver compact discs. Linear outline drawings of propeller aircraft are interspersed with vertical yellow stripes, painted gestural marks in red and yellow, and fragmentary photographic and printed paper elements.
works.title: Roundel Field
Snake on a Stairwell
works.description: Black-and-white serpent mural spans diagonally across a concrete wall beneath an exterior metal staircase, its open-fanged head rendered in bold outline style. Below the stairs, a pasted cartoon toast character with limbs occupies the lower section; four HVAC units are mounted at the upper wall, and a red commercial bin sits at ground level.

works.title: Untitled (Football Frieze)
works.description: Wide horizontal collage: a row of bullseye targets and footballs runs across the lower margin while two top-down warplane drawings cross the upper field. Red, yellow and black accents punctuate the white ground.
works.composition: horizontal panorama, target-and-football base frieze

works.title: Resin and Rust
works.description: Two rust-brown resin rectangles separated by a horizontal band of pale blue tape occupy the left two-thirds of the composition, while the right section consists of layered cream and pale green panels joined by four gold compact discs used as fasteners, with a small blue square visible at the upper edge.
works.composition: four-panel asymmetric grid

works.title: Roundel Procession
works.description: Vertical mixed-media collage incorporating a hand-drawn warplane, scattered compact discs, multiple concentric-circle targets in red, blue, green, and yellow, and two footballs against a white ground. Four yellow vertical bands bisect the composition; a small framed image is affixed near center, and the word 'GUERNICA' appears in the lower third.
works.composition: vertical procession on all-over roundel ground
asymmetric horizontal with framed inset left
works.description: Collage elements—compact discs, concentric target roundels, a yellow-bordered inset depicting a warplane and pink football—scatter across a white ground with pencil-drawn outlines of vehicles. Along the right margin, vertically stacked iridescent discs and horizontal color-bar stripes anchor the composition.
works.title: Untitled (Sketch, Pink Ball)
Inventory 10054
works.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating target concentric circles, two footballs, a small photographic insert depicting a red automobile, handwritten text listing names, and gestural ink markings across a white ground. Cutout figures, gear forms, a syringe illustration, and typed numerals '10054' layer over painted spiral and radiating motifs in red, black, and yellow.
works.composition: central black panel with corner-football anchors
central helicopter on dense target field
works.description: Layered collage of aircraft technical diagrams, concentric target rings, vinyl record discs, and bold pink and yellow planes of color across a predominantly white ground. Recurring bullseye motifs in red, black, and cyan overlap drawn warplane silhouettes, a chess-piece profile, gridded schematics, and typographic fragments throughout the densely packed vertical composition.
works.title: Untitled (Helicopter on Targets)
Cardboard Field
works.description: Quiet brown corrugated-cardboard field interrupted by a vivid orange rectangle at upper center and a turquoise football icon below. Small printed snapshots and two CDs anchor the lower edge; restrained palette unusual for the artist.
works.composition: muted cardboard field with orange focal block

works.title: Untitled (Target Field, Wide)
works.description: Collaged mixed-media composition on a horizontal field populated with concentric target circles, compact discs, two red American footballs, and a drawn warplane silhouette against a cream and ochre ground. Red orthogonal lines traverse the surface, overlapping printed ephemera, photographic fragments, and blue radiating arc forms distributed across multiple registers.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field
axial vertical totem with text band
works.description: Vertical mixed-media collage incorporating a top-down technical drawing of a warplane centered on a white ground, flanked by concentric target circles in red, black, and white. Scattered elements include a football, helmet, chess piece, compact discs, postage stamps, and the stenciled word 'WHAT,' with red rectangular patches and striped borders framing the composition.
works.title: Untitled (Plane Totem with Text)
Crown of Polaroids
works.description: Collaged mixed-media composition incorporating two compact discs mounted on concentric target circles, a red zigzag crown form, football trading cards in a horizontal strip, an American football image, and a small airplane outline against a pale blue ground, with a strip of repeated sports photographs along the upper margin.
works.composition: crown above polaroid band, disc and football below

works.title: Rhode, White Figure
works.description: Layered street-art markings cover a black metal wall, centered on a white paste-up figure of a standing nude with loosely rendered features. Yellow spray-painted lettering, a cartoon character with large concentric eyes, white line-drawn tags, and scattered graffiti inscriptions in white and yellow surround the central figure.
works.composition: central pasted figure on dark wall
wide horizontal panorama, all-over dense field
works.description: Dense collage incorporating repeated motifs—footballs, concentric bullseye targets, chess pawns, compact discs, and aircraft outlines—layered across a white ground bisected by bold red and black vertical bands. Gold foil, holographic material, and painted passages accumulate across the horizontal field alongside scattered soccer balls and cartoon figures.
works.title: Untitled (Dense Field)
Dad, Two Footballs
works.description: Mixed-media collage on white ground incorporates painted target circles, two footballs, collaged compact discs along the upper edge, and a central orange-framed inset depicting a warplane silhouette against black. Scattered across the surface are a small sculptural face, a gray figurative cutout, blue-arc lines, and hand-lettered text reading 'DAD' at lower right.
works.composition: framed inset center, target satellites

works.title: Foil Cross
works.description: Horizontal mixed-media assemblage incorporating reflective mylar sheeting, a cross-shaped foil structure mounted at upper center, and thirteen gold compact discs distributed across the composition. Red vertical ribbon strips descend against the mirrored ground; a computer keyboard lies detached to the left on a white surface, with printed labels and white cord elements visible throughout.
works.composition: central cross on horizontal foil ground
square dense field with text base
works.description: Densely packed square composition: top-down warplane drawings rise from a base inscribed 'GUERNICA', surrounded by footballs, target rings and silver compact discs. The signature war narrative compacted into a single saturated panel.
works.title: Guernica

works.composition: framed central plane on stacked targets
works.description: Collaged mixed-media composition featuring two gold compact discs positioned at the upper register above a top-down aircraft schematic overlaid with concentric target rings and reel-to-reel imagery. Surrounding margins incorporate warplane motifs, orange and green geometric blocks, yellow diagonal lines, and a horizontal row of red-and-white bullseye circles along the lower border.
works.title: Untitled (Framed Plane on Targets)
Untitled (Two Boards)
works.description: Two stacked rectangular panels: the upper has a black chess king and music note, the lower a red-and-black 'PINTE' panel with chess pieces. Silver compact discs ring the outer edge; small icons and text scribbles fill the margins.
works.composition: two stacked panels on disc-edged ground
wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field
works.description: Dense accumulation of collaged elements—concentric target rings, compact discs, chess pieces, skateboards, and printed text fragments—distributed across a white ground overlaid with red and yellow geometric grid lines. Circular motifs in black, red, yellow, and blue recur at varied scales throughout the composition, interspersed with schematic drawings and handwritten inscriptions.
works.title: Untitled (Skateboards on Target Field)

works.composition: wide horizontal panorama, twin disc center
works.description: Wide horizontal mixed-media collage centered on a yellow rectangular panel bearing two silver compact discs as eyes, forming a face-like configuration framed by thick black arcs. Concentric target circles, aircraft silhouettes, football forms, handwritten text reading 'XXXIII,' red and green vertical bands, and scattered circular motifs populate the surrounding white ground.
works.title: XXIII Bus

works.composition: horizontal trio of planes on muted ground
works.description: Multiple warplane silhouettes rendered in black line drawing occupy a yellow-and-white ground, arranged in overhead perspective across the horizontal field. Scattered compact discs, concentric target circles, photographic strips, and the hand-lettered phrase "THE KING OF" populate the surrounding collaged surface alongside small figure groups and vertical orange rectangles.
works.title: Untitled (Three Planes, Yellow)

works.composition: grid of panels with repeated text
works.description: Grid-based mixed-media collage composed of overlapping rectangular panels on a white ground, populated with rendered warplane silhouettes, concentric target circles in black, red, and multicolor, football imagery, chess pieces, and repeated stenciled text reading 'OTHER.' Orange, red, and white tones dominate the lower registers.
works.title: Untitled (Plane Grid, OTHER)
Occupy Democracy
works.description: Paste-up mural on a black ground depicts an ochre-yellow silhouetted profile of a crowned figure occupying the upper register, overlaid with repeated 'occupydemocracy' text strips and red lettering reading 'BEN NAZ.' Below, a grey-blue owl rendered in hatched brushwork adjoins a white Georgian door numbered 178A bearing small red snowman tags.
works.composition: central paste-up beside Georgian doorway

works.title: Guernica, Tall
works.description: Vertical digital collage bearing the text 'GuErNiCa' in mixed-case letters across a red-and-black urban texture at top; below, mirrored fragmented faces with yellow eyes are overlaid by horizontal color bands—cyan, yellow, red—while warplane silhouettes and compact discs occupy the lower registers against black-and-white photographic strips.
works.composition: axial vertical totem with text crown

works.title: Falling City
works.description: Vertical composite assembled on a white ground: mirrored photographic portrait fragments with orange eyes are overlaid with cyan, yellow, and red color-field bands, surmounted by a descending warplane silhouette rendered in teal and green. Below, a dense black-and-white aerial photograph of a destroyed urban landscape forms the base register.
works.composition: axial vertical totem, narrative descent

works.title: Guernica, Bomber Above
works.description: Vertical collage juxtaposing a cyan field bearing a schematic four-engine bomber overhead with the word 'GuErNiC' in white bold type on green; below, a red rectangle frames a black-and-white photograph of a ruined building and tree, with a dense photographic band of figures and rubble at bottom.
works.composition: two-register flag, bomber over destruction photograph

works.title: Foil Cross with Wires
works.description: Cross-shaped assemblage constructed from cardboard, crumpled copper-toned foil, compact discs, and small electronic components, mounted against a layered metallic and red-striped background. White wires descend loosely from the horizontal arms; a small purple-labeled disc is affixed near the lower vertical shaft, and yellow painted marks are visible at center.
works.composition: central cross on foil ground with dripping wires

works.title: Untitled (Page on Bands)
works.description: Mixed-media collage centered on a white rectangular panel bearing scattered paint marks and handwritten text, overlaid on vertical yellow bands; surrounding field incorporates concentric target motifs, compact discs, printed ephemera, black brushwork, and fragments of photographic and grid-patterned materials in red, blue, gold, and black.
works.composition: central blank panel on roundel field, disc base
cassette-shaped panel with disc reels
works.description: Collage elements—floppy disks, compact discs, cassette tape strips, and painted yellow vertical bands—form a rectangular frame enclosing a white void on a textured white ground. Six gold-toned CDs line the lower edge, two positioned as oversized reel spools, while multicolored circular motifs and mixed-media fragments populate the bottom register.
works.title: Cassette
Untitled (Page on Targets)
works.description: Mixed-media collage centering a white rectangular panel mounted with two silver compact discs and a translucent form, bordered by concentric target circles in red, black, pink, and blue. Scattered elements include a black chess king figure, football fragments, printed text reading 'xxxiii dia,' additional CDs, and horizontal bands of graphic patterning along the perimeter.
works.composition: central pinned page on target field

works.title: Untitled (Three Discs, Wide)
works.description: Collaged elements across a horizontal white ground include three Discraft compact discs positioned at varying heights, a row of concentric bullseye targets along the lower register, and geometric cutouts in cyan, orange, and red triangles at right. Photographic fragments depicting a football, chess pawn, and stacked discs occupy the left and lower margins.
works.composition: wide horizontal panorama with disc trio

works.title: Untitled (Three Discs, Quiet)
works.description: Three silver compact discs—one small in the upper right, one medium at mid-left, one large at center-lower—are arranged across an aged white ground bearing stain marks and edge perforations. Below the largest disc, a small technical drawing of a top-view aircraft appears above a red horizontal band at the bottom margin.
works.composition: diagonal disc descent on near-empty field
central twin planes with disc and ribbon field
works.description: Two horizontal warplane line drawings stack in the central register, surrounded by gold and silver compact discs and concentric rings. Pink, magenta and yellow ribbon stripes punctuate the field; a chess king stands at lower left and a bullseye anchors the base.
works.title: Untitled (Twin Planes with Discs)
Stencil Girl, Brick Wall
works.description: Black-and-white spray-paint stencil on weathered yellow brick depicting a child's face and torso, holding an object printed with repeating dollar signs rendered in white against black. Two small secondary stencils—a figure with glasses and a three-circle snowman—appear near the upper wall edge.
works.composition: central stencil on brick wall
empty centre with crowded perimeter
works.description: Crowded margins frame a near-empty central white panel: silver and gold compact discs, footballs, target rings, chess pieces and a soccer ball cluster densely along the four edges. The empty center reads as a pause within a busy field.
works.title: Untitled (White Frame, Crowded Margins)

works.composition: central inset with text tabs
works.description: Three gold compact discs anchor an inset white square at center, tagged with the painted words 'london' below and 'LIVERPOOL' on a yellow tab. A small line-drawn warplane, target rings and a black-and-white photographic strip frame the inset.
works.title: London, Liverpool
Untitled (Three Discs Above OTHER)
works.description: Three silver compact discs cluster in the central register over a base inscribed 'OTHER'. A small top-down warplane rises at the upper edge; a row of red-and-black bullseye targets and a magenta football line the lower frieze.
works.composition: central disc cluster with text base
open upper field, disc-and-target frieze base
works.description: Two top-down warplane drawings drift across the upper white field, one trailing a small cloud and red flag boxes; the painted word 'SURPRISE' marks the right edge. A horizontal row of gold compact discs and twin red bullseyes runs along the base. A wooden chess king stands at upper left.
works.title: Surprise
Cassette Altar
works.description: Vertical assemblage composed of layered paper documents, compact discs, blue tape strips, crumpled metallic foil, and assorted electronic components including a keyboard and small appliances, arranged against a black ground. Iridescent CDs appear in two registers—upper row affixed to white printed sheets, lower cluster mounted amid reflective foil and tangled cables.
works.composition: vertical altar with cascading ribbons
central bomber on black ground, target base
works.description: On a black ground a single white-line top-down bomber drawing hovers central, with two silver compact discs flanking targets at the lower edge. A small white chess king floats at upper left; teal accent strips punctuate the right side.
works.title: Bomber, Black Ground

works.composition: central blank panel within bordered frame
works.description: Layered collage elements—target rings in black-and-white and multicolor, multiple aircraft silhouettes in overhead and side-view orientations, two gold compact discs, and pale yellow drip marks—surround a central white panel bearing a single line-drawn jet. Cardboard, tape strips, and fragmented printed ephemera form the borders.
works.title: Untitled (Plane on Empty Page)

works.composition: framed plane swarm with disc descent
works.description: Four silver compact discs overlap a dense field of pencil-drawn warplane silhouettes rendered in multiple scales and orientations on a white ground. Red rectangular borders, vertical orange drips, concentric target circles in black and red, a blue X, and a partial magenta football accumulate across the surface; 'XXIII DBS' is inscribed lower right.
works.title: XXIII Discs

works.composition: axial squadron on black ground, target base
works.description: Negative-image variant: a black-ground panel hosts white-line top-down warplanes stacked vertically, framed by perforated borders and a base frieze of black-and-white concentric targets. Two silver compact discs sit in the lower margin.
works.title: Negative Squadron

works.composition: axial squadron on blue striped ground
works.description: Companion to the red-bordered XXIII piece, recast in cobalt blue: vertical blue stripes carry a flock of warplanes; iridescent and silver compact discs scatter across the upper field. Black-and-white target rings cluster at the base; inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
works.title: XXIII Discs, Blue
Star of David, Snowman
works.description: Red and violet ground supports overlapping white-outlined triangles forming a six-pointed star configuration, centered on a vertically oriented stylized automatic rifle rendered in green, black, and white. Within the lower inverted triangle, a small white snowman figure is depicted; yellow brushstrokes and gestural marks populate the layered background.
works.composition: central Star of David with figure
central football on near-empty field
works.description: Collaged on a white ground, multiple concentric target circles, line-drawn warplane silhouettes, a photographic football, black-and-white photographic fragments, and a chess piece are distributed across the vertical composition. Handwritten script appears along the right edge alongside thin colored strips of yellow, red, and green.
works.title: Football Drift

works.composition: spare narrative drawing with text base
works.description: Two warplane silhouettes—a small single-engine fighter at center and a large four-engine bomber at the lower edge—occupy a white paper ground marked with dotted runway lines, a circular pencil arc, target roundels, and two compact discs near the upper margin. Handwritten inscription reading 'Merry Christmas 2013 Allison' runs along the bottom edge.
works.title: Merry Christmas 1
Football, Black Ground
works.description: On a near-black ground a single American football looms at centre, surrounded by small bullseye eyes, scattered photographic snapshots and a wide horizontal red line. Hot-pink accents flicker at the upper edge; a small line-drawn warplane at the right.
works.composition: central football on dark ground
spare narrative drawing on black ground
works.description: Companion to the white-ground Christmas piece, recast on a black ground: a small green-and-white fighter at the upper centre approaches a four-engine bomber at the base. Two gold compact discs hang in the upper field; a circular ghost trace centres the composition.
works.title: Merry Christmas 2013, Black

central plane on cyan ground, axial drip columns

works.composition: vertical suspension on pegboard background

works.title: Untitled (Assembled Apparatus)
works.description: Layered assemblage of metallic foil, tape, cardboard framing, and found objects arranged in a roughly frontal composition. A large circular ring dominates the upper section, above iridescent banding and a lower rectangular element containing coiled wire.
works.composition: Vertical stack, circular ring over layered base

works.title: Untitled (Cracked Resin Grid)
works.description: Layered resin panel encasing cracked and fragmenting paper layers, with two horizontal green stripes dividing the composition into zones. Embedded imagery near center includes a magenta and blue rectangular fragment, while yellow appears along the lower edge.
works.composition: horizontal bands over cracked layered ground

works.title: Untitled (Fabric on Frame)
works.description: Pale fabric or canvas is pinned across a rustic wooden frame by a row of nails or pegs, photographed at close range with high-key exposure. Grid lines visible through the translucent material suggest layered substrate beneath.
works.composition: central fabric panel suspended on horizontal frame

works.title: House with Gold Foil
works.description: Layered collage centers on a cut-out house form rendered in grey tones, flanked by brick-textured and corrugated paper fragments. Gold and silver foil, iridescent elements, and a red vertical strip occupy the lower register against a dark background with blue and green paint.
works.composition: central house form over layered foil base

works.title: Neon City Skyline
works.description: Densely packed urban skyline rendered in vivid neon colors against a red-orange gradient sky, with a glowing disc form upper left and a pink moon upper right. Foreground features a horizontal railing structure in iridescent yellow-green, suggesting a bridge or platform vantage point.
works.composition: panoramic cityscape with foreground bridge railing

works.title: Projection onto Face
works.description: Double-exposure or projection photograph showing a human profile submerged beneath layered imagery of illuminated architectural or vehicular interiors. Blue, orange, and iridescent light bands obscure the upper face, leaving only the chin and neck visible against a deep black ground.
works.composition: profile face beneath projected light bands

works.title: Stacked Painted Blocks 2
works.description: Hundreds of painted concrete or foam blocks in varied geometric forms — cubes, cylinders, arches — are stacked floor-to-ceiling in dense, grid-like layers. Colors span the full spectrum, with blue, orange, red, and pink predominating across the tightly packed composition.
works.composition: dense floor-to-ceiling stacked block grid

works.title: City Under Laser Sky
works.description: Dense nocturnal cityscape rendered in vivid neon colors, with illuminated skyscrapers spanning the full width of the composition. Radiating laser beams cross a red-orange sky above a suspended conical lamp, with dark cloud forms silhouetted against the fiery upper register.
works.composition: panoramic cityscape beneath radiating laser beams

works.title: Untitled (Grid Over Architecture)
works.description: Ink-drawn grid overlays a rectangular panel bearing faint architectural imagery rendered in grey and white tones. Two circular forms appear at the lower edge of the composition, and gestural cross-hatching reinforces the grid structure throughout.
works.composition: dense grid overlay on architectural ground

works.title: Neon City Nocturne
works.description: Densely layered cityscape rendered in vivid neon hues depicts a sprawling nocturnal skyline beneath an orange-red sky with abstracted cloud forms. Foreground features horizontal grid-like structures in turquoise and gold, while illuminated building windows and colored light beams animate the urban scene.
works.composition: panoramic layered cityscape with foreground grid

works.title: Polaroid Self-Portrait
works.description: Heavily light-leaked large-format film self-portrait shows a figure holding a Polaroid Land Camera at face level, obscuring features. Saturated orange and yellow tones dominate, with visible sprocket holes along both vertical edges indicating medium-format or 35mm roll film.
works.composition: centered figure with camera obscuring face

works.title: Untitled (Interference Rings)
works.description: Saturated yellow ground bears three horizontal bands of concentric interference rings rendered in red and green. Elliptical wave forms radiate outward from focal points, creating an optical moiré pattern across the picture plane.
works.composition: three horizontal bands of radiating rings

works.title: Untitled (Boat Interior Plan)
works.description: Top-down architectural floor plan of a small boat interior rendered in ink and watercolor wash. Seating, steering wheel, and storage compartments are labeled, including a handwritten annotation reading 'COOLER / STORAGE' at lower right.
works.composition: bird's-eye plan centered on vertical axis

works.title: Untitled (Installation View) 3
works.description: Installation view of a red-saturated gallery or studio space featuring iridescent silver-gold panels, framed photographic portraits on the wall, and a dark sculptural figure in the foreground. Blue light illuminates the lower foreground, contrasting with warm amber and red ambient lighting throughout the space.

works.title: Untitled (Studio Group Shot)
works.description: Group of approximately seven figures gathered on a studio floor, one person mid-motion above the group. Posters and artworks cover the walls behind them, including a large marine-themed image; clothing hangs on a rack to the right.

works.title: Untitled (Foil and Light)
works.description: Installation or studio view dominated by crumpled silver foil draped over LED or pixel-grid panels emitting blue, magenta, and green light. Suspended bare bulb glows blue at left; reflective honeycomb-patterned surfaces create layered iridescent zones across the lower half.
works.composition: foil draped over illuminated grid panels

works.title: Floydband Burped and Puked
works.description: Mixed-media collage featuring a central photographic scene of figures surrounding mannequin heads, overlaid with iridescent rainbow lettering spelling 'FLOYDBAND' and handwritten psychedelic text reading 'Burped and Puke Game All My Nose.' Three-dimensional cut-out letters spelling 'FLOYDBAND' appear on the left spine against a hot-pink ground.
works.composition: central photographic inset flanked by 3D lettering

works.title: Untitled (Portrait, Upward Gaze)
works.description: Portrait photograph of a figure wearing dark sunglasses, a black t-shirt, and a white scarf wrapped at the neck. Face is tilted upward against a muted blue-grey background, with directional light casting shadow across the jaw and cheek.
works.composition: upward-tilted portrait against plain background

works.title: Design: Electrical Gulf Cart
works.description: Scaled technical rendering of an electric golf cart shown from the front, dated 10/76 and attributed to designer Jeff Neumann. Watercolor and ink on drafting paper depicts two upholstered seats, a steering wheel, yellow headlights, and a dimensional annotation of 19 inches width.
works.composition: centered front-elevation technical drawing

works.title: Masked Figure with Scarf
works.description: Figure wearing a textured pink-and-green mask with white cat-eye glasses, photographed against a dark background. White fabric scarf drapes over the shoulders, contrasting with a black garment beneath.
works.composition: centered masked torso against dark background

works.title: Untitled (Installation View) 4
works.description: Installation view of a red-walled gallery space featuring iridescent sequined or metallic fabric panels arranged horizontally across a central structure. Blue accent lighting illuminates the lower foreground, while a framed artwork glows under warm yellow light in a recessed upper niche.

works.title: Untitled (Live Concert Stage)
works.description: Low-angle concert photograph captures three figures on a darkened stage under warm stage lighting. Two guitarists flank a central vocalist; Marshall amplifier stacks are visible in the background.

works.title: Untitled (Electric Typewriter)
works.description: Studio photograph of a vintage electric typewriter, black and ivory in color, with a sheet of paper loaded into the carriage. Brand markings are partially legible; the machine appears to be in active or recent use.

works.title: Untitled (Studio Wall Collage)
works.description: Studio wall photograph showing the King Crimson 'In the Court of the Crimson King' album cover prominently displayed, with a circular rainbow sticker affixed to its upper left. Surrounding record sleeves and photographs, including a 'Runt' album below, form a dense collage arrangement.
keywords: King Crimson album cover wall display

works.title: Untitled 7 (Studio Interior)
works.description: Studio interior photographed through a reflective glass surface, creating layered double-exposure effects. Visible elements include an orange triangle shape on a wall, art supplies, a wire trolley stacked with markers, and ambient incandescent lighting.
works.composition: layered reflection through glass surface
